description: This file declares the ResourceManager class, which implements plugin and JSON-RPC interfaces for resource management within the WPEFramework. It includes method declarations for initializing, deinitializing, and managing resource-related operations such as setting AV blocking, retrieving blocked applications, and reserving TTS resources.

classes.name: ResourceManager
classes.description: A class implementing plugin and JSON-RPC interfaces for resource management, including methods for AV blocking, application blocking, and TTS resource reservation.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided shell service.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin with the provided shell service.

methods.name: setAVBlockedWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method to set AV blocking status for a client.

methods.name: getBlockedAVApplicationsWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method to retrieve list of applications with AV blocked status.

methods.name: reserveTTSResourceWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method to reserve TTS resource for a client.

methods.name: reserveTTSResourceWrapperForApps
methods.description: Wrapper method to reserve TTS resources for multiple applications.

methods.name: setAVBlocked
methods.description: Sets AV blocked status for a specific client.

methods.name: getBlockedAVApplications
methods.description: Retrieves list of applications with AV blocked status.

methods.name: reserveTTSResource
methods.description: Reserves TTS resource for a specific client.

methods.name: reserveTTSResourceForApps
methods.description: Reserves TTS resources for multiple clients.
